entries.name: 三角帽子でおめでとう・手を振って
entries.prompt:
Create ONE photorealistic FULL-BODY transparent cutout for a birthday photo-compositing app. Reference image 1 is the IDENTITY reference: preserve the exact recognizable face, warm smile, age, Japanese ethnicity, natural gray hair, wrinkles, and mature body proportions of the elderly man Kozo. His familiar gentle face must be immediately recognizable, do not make him younger or make another person. Interpret the specific celebration clothing and props below faithfully. Festive and endearing but natural, not a cartoon. One person only. Both arms, hands and feet anatomically plausible and attached; correctly scaled real-world props securely held or worn. Head to toe with entire hat, both feet and all props completely within frame, at least 80px transparent padding at top and bottom and 50px on sides. Full-body three-quarter view facing camera, realistic fabric and skin, soft neutral studio light. Real alpha transparency everywhere around subject and between limbs; no background, ground, shadows, stage, checkerboard, halo or detached floating objects. No other people, logos, readable words, invented numerals or watermark.
Birthday costume, props and pose: Light mint polo shirt, beige trousers and black shoes like reference, plus a colorful small striped conical birthday party hat secured on head and a bright bow tie. Give a friendly open-handed wave; other hand relaxed. No other objects.
